name: Josh Sposato
body:
I’ve been waiting to post this because i’m just now realizing how large Pauly’s reach was. He had his hand in everything that was authentic in Rhode Island. He was a boots on the ground guy who gave it all to cultivate a positive and inclusive music community. When I first started DJing he was like the big brother I never had. He would pick me up and bring me to salon when we both had gigs on the same night. He advocated for me as a struggling kid who needed to make extra cash doing something I love. For him it was NEVER about the money. From ice cream and reggae on the ride home to impromptu bike rides around the city… you will be missed!!!!!

 Thank you Pauly!!!! 💕
